verdict.rationale: Floot is an AI app builder, so a pre-launch security review is a fair question for this kind of product. The pack contains no evidence of one: the security-and-data page only mentions SQL dumps, and the secure key-entry dialog is an adjacent secrets-handling feature, not a security review of the generated app. One-click publish is documented with no review step.

support.subject: As a developer, I can have the platform review my generated app for security issues before it goes live
